sent: The provider (APNs, FCM, HMS, UnifiedPush) accepted the message.
delivered: Only the displayed receipt of the mobile SDK (client_sdk); provider acceptance is never delivery.
engagement: The displayed and clicked receipts of the SDK.
note: Without an SDK receipt the delivery stays sent and is reported as accepted by the provider; push has no DLR window and never becomes unknown.

sent: The push service accepted the message (201).
delivered: Only the displayed receipt of the web SDK (client_sdk); provider acceptance is never delivery.
engagement: The displayed and clicked receipts of the SDK.
note: Without an SDK receipt the delivery stays sent; there is no DLR window.

sent: The ESP or the connected MTA accepted the message.
delivered: The provider's delivery event or a success DSN; a human click.
engagement: Open (unreliable) and click, human and bot told apart.
note: An asynchronous bounce after delivery is valid.

delivered: A DLR with the delivered state.
note: A DLR can be hours late or never come (DS-18).

delivered: The provider's answered or completed event.
engagement: The keypad answer, where there is one.
note: The details are in the provider rows.

engagement: Read (the recipient can turn it off; its absence is no information) and an interactive reply.

delivered: None: the platform gives no delivery information.
engagement: An interactive reply; a card button is never an approval.
note: Delivery and read information are capability flags that are off.
